# Bundled dependencies

Pose & Tell vendors these browser libraries so the app can run from a static
folder. They retain their original licenses:

- **TensorFlow.js 1.3.1** — Apache License 2.0. See `tfjs.LICENSE.txt`.
  <https://github.com/tensorflow/tfjs>
- **@teachablemachine/pose 0.8.5** — Apache License 2.0. See
  `teachablemachine-pose.LICENSE.txt`.
  <https://github.com/googlecreativelab/teachablemachine-libraries>
- **fflate 0.8.2** — MIT License. See `fflate.LICENSE.txt`.
  <https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate>

Fonts in `assets/fonts/` are Space Grotesk and Instrument Serif from Google
Fonts, licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
